title: Concept: Card number in a bulk export
description: An export row that carries a full card number in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The export leaves the controlled interface and lands on a workstation, where the card number is one copy away from a fraud tool.
applicability: Deployments that render an export row that carries a full card number into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The export leaves the controlled interface and lands on a workstation, where the card number is one copy away from a fraud tool.
